items.title: Gaussian comparison behind Fact 10 — generalized analytic ingredient

source.anchor: Section 6.2 Fact 10 and its complete symmetry/cosh proof
source.attribution: Huanjian Zhou and Taiji Suzuki, CC BY 4.0. ASTIS separates the generalized analytic ingredient below from the unproved literal-load and conditional-iteration adapters; no endorsement implied.

items.statement: Source Fact 10: for the paper's truncated load U_i, a centered Gaussian variable Y (possibly degenerate), and a∈[0,1], E exp(−aU_i(Y))≤exp(β_i² Var(Y)/2). The standing definition is U_i(y)=nβ_i²/λ·φ(λy/(nβ_i)), with positive n,β_i,λ and the source's smooth odd φ satisfying |φ(t)|≤|t|. The local result generalizes the symmetry/cosh part to any measurable odd sublinear load; it does not yet verify the actual U_i adapter.
assumptions: Y is centered Gaussian; zero variance is explicitly allowed.
a∈[0,1]. The literal load and its source parameters are fixed as in Section6.2, inheriting smoothness/oddness from φ.
For the generalized ingredient, U is Borel measurable and odd with |U(y)|≤β|y|. These are not proposed new binders on a source main theorem.

obligations.label: Prove exponential integrability from Gaussian domination
Prove the sharp generalized symmetry/cosh comparison
Derive the required properties of the literal source U_i (open)

bindings.boundary: Generalized ingredient only. Literal U_i adapter remains uncovered, as do conditional factorization, level recursion, Tonelli and Lemma6.2. Do not promote helper hypotheses into assumptions of the actual paper result.

assumption_deltas.source: The fixed smooth truncated load U_i from the preceding paragraph
assumption_deltas.lean: Arbitrary Borel measurable U with Function.Odd U and ∀y, |U y|≤β|y|
assumption_deltas.reason: Expose precisely the structural properties used by the source's symmetry/cosh argument. Their derivation for literal U_i remains an explicit separate obligation, not an asserted completed adapter.

assumption_deltas.source: Centered Gaussian Y, possibly degenerate, and its variance
assumption_deltas.reason: Direct integration against the Gaussian law; v=0 is Dirac0. Applying the ingredient on another probability space uses the existing law-map integral API and a separately established actual Gaussian law.

assumption_deltas.source: a∈[0,1]; positive β_i in the standing parameters
assumption_deltas.reason: Sublinearity already implies β≥0; β=0 is allowed and forces U=0. No strict-positivity restriction is needed by the analytic argument.

assumption_deltas.source: Expectation splitting and comparison implicitly require finite moments
assumption_deltas.lean: Integrable exp(-a U) is concluded; both exponential signs and cosh integrability are derived internally
assumption_deltas.reason: Measurable domination by exp(βy)+exp(-βy) justifies the source proof without adding an integrability premise.
